capabilities: Display dynamically-scoped collapsible tree views of relationships rooted at the current note
Define custom superordinate and coordinate relationships via frontmatter property keys
Embed navigation views in notes with a bearings code block
Augment node display with title prefixes from note properties
extras: Iconography and colors are currently fixed; customization, custom views, and custom category filters are listed as future plans.
motivation: The author was categorizing notes along multiple hierarchies modeled on the Python Package Index classifier system and wanted to traverse them.
problem: Obsidian's links and backlinks don't expose semantic relationships stored in frontmatter as scoped, expandable hierarchies.

relations.evidence: Dataview is required to be installed
Hovering over links opens up the Hover Editor (if installed)

summary: Navigation plugin that shows collapsible tree views of note relationships defined by links in frontmatter property keys.
